content.intro: This lesson focuses on databases and server-side persistence and the practical choices around it. Start with the smallest example, connect it to “Database access patterns”, and verify the result before adding complexity.

content_blocks.text: **Start with the rule.** Treat database access patterns as a specialist or version-sensitive area. Verify target support and toolchain assumptions first, isolate platform-specific code, and document limitations instead of treating experimental support as universal.

common_mistakes.problem: Assuming every Swift snippet can run in a browser or on every operating system.

common_mistakes.fix: Run command-line examples locally; use Xcode or a compatible package/target for framework-specific material.
